activities.description: Narrator introduces the topic and explains the problem of lag on secondary monitors for gaming laptops.
Narrator instructs viewers to change power settings to High Performance.
Narrator transitions to the main solution, mentioning he still had lag after changing power settings.

scenes.contextualRelevance: The scene introduces the problem faced by gamers and the initial steps to address it.

scenes.title: Introduction to the Problem and Initial Steps

videoEditingDetails.description: Screen recording of the desktop, no transitions or effects. Suggestion: The intro could be shortened to be more concise and jump to the main solution quicker.

activities.description: Narrator instructs viewers to open Device Manager.
Narrator explains how to identify the graphics card responsible for the secondary monitor.
Narrator demonstrates disabling the Intel HD Graphics driver.
Narrator shows the screen switching to the secondary monitor after disabling the driver.
Narrator drags the Device Manager window back to the primary monitor.
Narrator explains that the secondary monitor is now the primary display for gaming.
Narrator emphasizes the importance of enabling the Intel driver after finishing gaming.
Narrator demonstrates enabling the Intel driver.
Narrator switches back to the secondary monitor by disabling the Intel driver.
Narrator summarizes the solution and thanks viewers.

scenes.contextualRelevance: The scene provides a detailed walkthrough of solving the lag issue, making it relevant for gamers facing similar problems.

climax.description: The narrator disables the Intel driver, making the secondary monitor the primary display for gaming, thereby eliminating the lag.
